profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Go, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Distributed Systems | Real-time health data at scale (HIPAA) | ChartSpan (formerly Validic)
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer with 25+ years building and leading backend and distributed systems, the last 9 in real-time health data at scale. Go, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes on AWS in a HIPAA-compliant environment.

At ChartSpan (formerly Validic) I'm a technical lead for the remote patient monitoring platform that manages care for 225,000+ patients, built on Go and Kotlin microservices on Kubernetes against a 99.9% uptime SLA. The platform sits on top of a data pipeline that ingests millions of patient-generated readings a day across 700+ device integrations.

Recent highlights:
• Led replacement of synchronous REST notifications with an asynchronous
  Kafka-based system delivering tens of thousands of critical-reading
  alerts daily
• Led replacement of an InfluxDB-backed readings service with a Go service
  on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — cut p99 latency 90% and eliminated
  recurring outages
• Co-led a 3-week pivot of our remote patient monitoring platform into a
  COVID monitoring solution credited with reducing mortality nearly 50%
  and emergency care/hospital admissions 20%
• As Software Development Manager, led teams of 5-8 engineers on the same
  RPM platform

Technical lead and former engineering manager who mentors senior and staff
engineers and drives architecture decisions across teams.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer / Technical Lead
positions.description:
Technical lead for the remote patient monitoring platform managing care for
225,000+ patients. I own architecture for the Go and Kotlin services behind
it and lead cross-team efforts like moving clinical alerting to Kafka and
replacing the InfluxDB readings store with Aurora PostgreSQL. Also mentor
senior and staff engineers across the org.

Validic was acquired by ChartSpan in June 2026.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description:
Managed the teams building and running the RPM platform. Co-led the 3-week
pivot that turned it into a COVID monitoring solution during the pandemic,
and moved the team to fully remote work.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend engineer on the early RPM platform, building Go and Java services
that fed patient-generated health data into clinician workflows. Wrote the
tooling that migrated 18,000 patients off a legacy system.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend engineer on a real-time ad bidding platform handling tens of
billions of transactions a day. Built the brand-safety systems in Java and
Scala/Spark that kept ads off inappropriate inventory, and maintained the
C# bidding and delivery code.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Scala · C# · PostgreSQL · Python · Scalability · Agile Methodologies · Scala in Spark · Real-Time Bidding (RTB)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built the C# management layer for live video encoders used by Comcast, ESPN,
Yahoo!, and NBC Universal, including the encoding management behind NBC's
Olympic streaming coverage.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Inlet Technologies was acquired by Cisco in March 2011. Same product and role; see the Cisco position

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Database Administrator
positions.description: C# and SQL Server engineer on battlefield management and enterprise corporate filing products, covering WCF services, database design and administration, ETL, and the installer. Held a DoD Secret clearance (now inactive).
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · C# · Databases · Oracle Database · Database Design · Database Administration

positions.title: Technical Lead / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech lead for IACRA, the FAA's national pilot certification web application. Led a 5-person .NET team, designed the registration and security components and the SQL Server backend, and served as liaison between development, support, and the FAA. Released in 2003 to 100,000+ users.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · Database Design · Software Design · C# · Software Development · Team Management

positions.title: Co-Founder / Chief Technical Officer
positions.description: Co-founded and ran technology for a comparison shopping site covering 1.3 million products from 150+ retailers. Built the SQL Server backend and led a small engineering team.
positions.insights: Skills: Leading Development Teams · Microsoft SQL Server · ASP.NET · Data Modeling
